title: Who's on the mountains? The birthplaces of the people the world's peaks are named after
excerpt: I linked 2,228 mountains named after people to their namesakes' birthplaces. 84% of the person-named peaks of Australia and New Zealand honour someone born on another continent.
seo_description: Whose names are on the world's mountains? 2,228 peaks linked to their namesakes' birthplaces: the colonial survey layer, mapped.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Who's on the mountains?' in black and red on parchment, beside a world map with coloured lines from mountains to the birthplaces of the people they are named after, and the lines '84% of the person-named peaks of Australia and New Zealand honour someone born on another continent' and 'Only 5.1% honour a woman'.
